speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms; have you noticed any scaling, thickening, or discoloration of the skin, and do these sensory changes extend to your fingers?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT). The combination of photosensitive rash on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body) and neurological symptoms (numbness/tingling) in a patient with potential liver stressors (livestock farming) strongly suggests PCT. I request results for: Liver_Function_Tests, Uroporphyrin, and Hepatitis_C_status.
